exposure: Oxytocin infusion rates (0, 1, 2, 3, 5, or 8 IU h-1)
cohort: The study included 150 healthy term parturients scheduled for elective caesarean delivery under epidural anaesthesia.
finding: The 95% effective dose (ED95) of oxytocin infusion for adequate uterine tone was estimated to be 7.72 IU h-1 when administered after a 1 IU oxytocin bolus during elective cesarean delivery.
